articles.title: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink
articles.description: With smartphone sales tanking by around 20 percent compared to 2025, Qualcomm is looking to data centers to help boost its bottom line. During its Q4 2026 earnings call, the company laid out its plans to make a splash in the AI data center business, through partnerships with companies like Amazon and Meta announced earlier […] [www.theverge.com] With smartphone sales tanking by around 20 percent compared to 2025, Qualcomm is looking to data centers to help boost its bottom line. During its Q4 2026 earnings call, the company laid out its plans to make a splash in the AI data center business, through partnerships with companies like Amazon and Meta announced earlier this year. The company expects that portion of its business to grow quickly, forecasting around $650 million in data center revenue during the first quarter of 2027. But it anticipates that will reach $5 billion by the end of 2027 and $15 billion by 2029. [...] Qualcomm is b [shattered.io] The distinction carries weight for anyone building a model. A $5 billion fiscal 2027 figure rests on guidance language. A $15 billion outcome two years later would require tripling again, and no confirmed source lays out the path. Readers should treat the 2029 figure as a reported ambition. The same caution applies to the phrase betting big. Reporters use it because Qualcomm is redirecting engineering and capital toward an unproven market. Qualcomm itself has described a portfolio, customer collaborations and a revenue ramp, and has not used that framing.
